_rules: A person appears on the public site only after Kevan confirms the relationship and the person says yes. Role lines state history, never endorsement. Working notes are kept outside this repository.

people.name: John Mayotte
people.relationship: Kevan's college coach at Troy. Years later, when Kevan was director of baseball at Montverde Academy, he hired Coach Mayotte as head coach for the season; he and his wife lived on campus.
people.public_facts: Troy head coach 1991-2002; led Troy to the 1993 NCAA Division II College World Series; 386 wins at Troy. Died January 2022.

people.name: Cam Walker
people.relationship: Kevan's college coach at Indian Hills Community College. He came to Montverde Academy for Scout Day, so both of Kevan's college coaches helped run the camp.
people.public_facts: Indian Hills head coach 1993-2018; NJCAA Baseball Coaches Association Hall of Fame (2012).

people.name: Rick Schu
people.relationship: Kevan's hitting coach in the Arizona Diamondbacks system; 'the best hitting coach I ever had.' Kevan visited him at Nationals spring training (and brought a case of Budweiser).
people.public_facts: Coached with four Diamondbacks affiliates 1998-2001, then Arizona's minor league hitting coordinator and later its major league hitting coach; Washington Nationals hitting coach 2013-2017.

people.name: Mike Rizzo
people.relationship: Came to Kevan's grandmother's house and signed him for the Arizona Diamondbacks
people.public_facts: Arizona Diamondbacks scout from 1998, then scouting director; Washington Nationals assistant GM 2007-2008 and general manager from 2009.

people.name: Alan Nero
people.relationship: Kevan's mentor; hired Kevan at Octagon, where Kevan worked for him in the baseball division
people.public_facts: Longtime baseball agent; founded CSMG, whose baseball unit joined Octagon; co-leads Octagon Baseball.

people.name: Hank Sargent
people.relationship: How we know him: to come.
people.public_facts: Florida Southern assistant coach 1986-1991; scouted for the Montreal Expos and Cincinnati Reds; Angels crosschecker; player agent.

people.name: Noro Padron
people.relationship: One of our players, from Cuba.

people.name: Tom Justice, "the Gringo"
people.relationship: Our coach in Panama, known there as the Gringo.

people.name: Johan Camargo
people.relationship: How we know him: to come.

people.name: Kyle Murphy
people.relationship: One of our players. He worked on his swing with Kevan in Beloit before the Texas Rangers drafted him.
people.public_facts: Drafted by the Texas Rangers in the 19th round, 2007 (Beloit Daily News, June 10, 2007).

people.name: Wyatt Olsen
people.relationship: One of our players. His father, Eric Olsen, brought Kevan back to baseball when Kevan moved home to Beloit, Wisconsin.

people.name: P.J. Connelly
people.relationship: Kevan's teammate on the 2005 Winnipeg Goldeyes. Both are from Beloit.
people.public_facts: Pitched for the Winnipeg Goldeyes in 2005, then in the Angels system (StatsCrew).

people.name: Jesus Hernandez
people.relationship: One of our players, from Cuba.
